ai_summary_zh: 本場區包含鋪面道路與人行步道，總面積約2520.2平方公尺，路面狀況良好。場區內共計41棵喬木，平均胸徑為20.0公分，並設有18處擋土牆或建築牆體，總垂直面積為396.8平方公尺。場區內無任何水域。
ai_summary_en: The site features paved roads and walkways covering approximately 2520.2 square meters in good condition. There are 41 trees with a mean DBH of 20.0 cm at 1.3m height, alongside 18 retaining or building walls with a total vertical area of 396.8 square meters. There are no water bodies present on the site.
